claims.explanation: Cinalukast is a cysteinyl leukotriene receptor 1 (CYSLTR1) antagonist that also activates PPARα. Its selective killing pattern is best explained by dependence on CYSLTR1 signaling and/or PPARα-mediated effects, with sensitivity enriched in lines with mutations in TP53, PTEN, and chromatin remodelers (e.g., PBRM1, ARID1A, SMARCA4), which may impair survival signaling and enhance drug-induced death. Conversely, KRAS mutations and high expression of CYSLTR1 or PPARα may protect cells, possibly through alternative survival pathways or reduced drug target engagement.
